condition: DataFrame.fillna(other_dataframe) where the filler has an object column coerces float64 columns to object (or int64 if values are integral) instead of preserving float64.
workaround: Fill column-wise, e.g. for each column use df[c].fillna(other[c]) or df[c].where(df[c].notna(), other[c]), so dtypes don't get coerced together.
